title: Introducing: Sustainability in Business Central (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: CSRD regulations and target customer segments
Sustainability tracking scope and emissions types
Demo data module and foundational features
Chart of Accounts, Journals, and Reporting

features.name: Sustainability journal
features.description: Recording and tracking greenhouse gas emissions data within Business Central. Includes both recurring and standard journal types with journal batches and templates following standard Business Central patterns. Users can record emissions either manually by entering amounts directly or using calculation formulas based on distance, fuel consumption, or other factors with emission factor calculations.
caveats: Limited to recording and reporting scope, not reduction or removal recommendations in this wave
Includes background error checking for validation

features.name: Chart of sustainability accounts
features.description: A structured framework for categorizing emissions similar to chart of accounts but measuring emission impact rather than financial impact. Sustainability-specific chart of accounts with category determination for scope tracking, emission type selection, and calculation type configuration. Includes support for totaling, heading and posting accounts similar to general ledger structure.
caveats: Demo data structure is not regulation-based, intended for demonstration purposes
Users can customize emission types tracked per account

features.name: Emissions calculation formulas
features.description: Built-in calculation methods and formulas to compute emissions amounts when exact emission quantities are not known, enabling flexible emissions tracking.

features.name: Sustainability ledger entries
features.description: Posted emissions records created through standard posting procedures from sustainability journal lines, serving as the data source for sustainability reporting. Posted sustainability ledger entries that store all recorded emissions after posting from sustainability journal, functioning similarly to general ledger entries and serving as the basis for reporting.

features.name: Standard sustainability reports
features.description: Out-of-the-box reporting functionality for sustainability data from ledger entries. Three reports available: total emissions, emission per facility, and emission by category. All reports use Excel layout as default with optional RDC layout support, featuring pivot tables, charts, and filtering capabilities for analysis.
caveats: Regulatory-specific reports to come in future waves
Excel layout is default, RDC layout still available but not primary

features.name: Sustainability APIs
features.description: API endpoints enabling external systems and solutions to connect with Business Central sustainability functionality, allowing partners and customers to extend functionality beyond the built-in interface.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will come probably in next one or two minors, we will enable all these entities through APIs
caveats: Planned for next one or two minor releases

features.name: Sustainability demo data module
features.description: Pre-configured demo module in Contoso demo tool including chart of sustainability accounts, categories, subcategories, populated sustainability journals, and posted ledger entries for training and customer demonstrations.
caveats: Demo chart of accounts can be shortened or expanded as needed
Users can customize the chart of accounts as needed

features.name: Carbon footprint, methane, and nitrogen dioxide tracking
features.description: Support for tracking the three emissions types with the biggest impact in the first wave: carbon footprint, methane, and nitrogen dioxide. The scope is extensible by partners and potentially Microsoft in future releases.
caveats: Limited to three types in this wave but extensible
Not limited only to these three types going forward

features.name: Sustainability setup page
features.description: Configuration page for sustainability module where users can configure unit of measure for different sustainability needs, rounding, decimal places, mandatory usage fields including country/region and responsibility center tracking.
caveats: Can support flexible unit of measure for different reporting requirements

features.name: Emission factor configuration in subcategories
features.description: Ability to define emission factors in sustainability subcategories that are used in calculations within the sustainability journal for automatic emission computation based on configured factors.
